name: io.github.moncef00327-cloud/quantum-aether
title: Quantum Aether
description: Post-quantum TLS readiness, Ed25519 signed receipts, PQ-TLS config generator, and x402 CBOM

tools.name: scan_tls
tools.description: Run a new, rate-limited TLS 1.3 scan of a public host (default port 443) to observe whether it negotiates hybrid post-quantum key exchange (X25519MLKEM768) and issue a signed Ed25519 JWS receipt (v1, policy qa-pqc-transport 1.0) verifiable offline via /.well-known/jwks.json. Use when you need a fresh measurement; use get_tls_evidence first if stored evidence is sufficient. Starts an external connection and stores a publicly accessible result. Does not judge application safety.

discovered_manifest.description: Optional discovery manifest path observed on the target host.

domain.description: Backward-compatible alias for host when scanning port 443.

endpoint_type.description: Optional endpoint classification recorded in the signed receipt metadata (e.g. mcp_remote, a2a, https).

host.description: Public hostname or IP address to probe for TLS 1.3 and X25519MLKEM768 key exchange, for example mcp.example.com.

tools.name: get_tls_evidence
tools.description: Read the latest valid stored signed TLS receipt by jti or host:port (or legacy domain evidence) without starting a network scan. Use this read-only lookup first before calling scan_tls. Returns RECEIPT_EXPIRED if the stored receipt expired. A missing record is not proof that a domain is unsafe.

domain.description: Public DNS hostname (backward-compatible alias for host on port 443).

host.description: Target hostname or host:port to look up the latest stored signed receipt without running a network scan.

jti.description: Exact signed receipt identifier (jti) returned previously by scan_tls.

tools.name: exposure_window
tools.description: Query the Quantum Exposure Registry for a public domain without scanning: returns first_observed date, first_pq_week (when post-quantum key exchange was first negotiated), observed harvest-now-decrypt-later classical exposure window (lower bound), regressions, weekly timeline with OpenTimestamps anchor proofs, and same-network peers. Read-only; external observation, not a compliance certification.

domain.description: Public DNS hostname without scheme or path, for example example.com. Inspected on HTTPS port 443 only.

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: Return the documented TLS measurement scope, observation_status definitions (observed_pq, observed_classical, undetermined), grading rules (A/B/C/F), signed receipt specification, and privacy limitations. Call before interpreting TLS scan results or making security claims. Read-only, no arguments.

tools.name: get_example_result
tools.description: Return an explicitly labeled archived example scan result (is_example=true, is_live=false) so clients can inspect the response structure without payment or network traffic. Read-only, no arguments.

tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: Return live endpoints, scan rate limits, pricing (free scans, $5.00 USDC attestation, $49 full report, $0.50 sector snapshot, 29/99 EUR monitoring, 290 EUR MSP Pilot), x402 Base USDC status, and documented limitations. Read-only, no arguments.

tools.name: generate_pq_config
tools.description: Return verified, copy-paste configuration and verification commands to enable hybrid post-quantum TLS (X25519MLKEM768 / ML-KEM) on nginx, Apache, HAProxy, Caddy, Go, Node.js, AWS CloudFront, or Cloudflare (with notes in en, ar, or de). Read-only, no external scan.

lang.description: Language for configuration notes and step headings (en, ar, or de).

server.description: Web server, reverse proxy, runtime, or CDN to configure for hybrid post-quantum TLS (X25519MLKEM768).

variant.description: Optional library/runtime version variant key. Omit to get the recommended default variant and list of all available variants.

tools.name: get_full_report
tools.description: Paid x402 tool: $49.00 USDC on Base per report (x402 v2, exact scheme, one-time per scan). Fetch the full remediation report for a completed scan_id. If unpaid, returns a standard x402 v2 PaymentRequired challenge for exact USDC on Base and never charges. An x402-enabled MCP client with a funded buyer wallet may sign and retry under explicit spend authorization. Payment is settled before report access is returned.

scan_id.description: Scan identifier returned by scan_tls. An x402-compatible MCP client handles the Base USDC payment challenge.

tools.name: get_sector_snapshot
tools.description: Paid x402 tool: $0.50 USDC on Base per call (x402 v2, exact scheme). Read-only dataset returning every domain in one sector watch list (banks, government, cyber agencies, telecom, insurers ...) from the latest weekly registry measurement, with grade, key-exchange group, TLS version, and post-quantum status, plus summary counts. Without a signed payment it returns the x402 PaymentRequired challenge and never charges. Sectors: audit-advisory-legal, banks-americas-apac, banks-dach, banks-europe, banks-mena, cloud-security, companies-dach, critical-infrastructure, crypto-exchanges, cyber-agencies-worldwide, enterprise-saas-b2b, finance-worldwide, global-insurance-healthcare, government-dach, government-gcc, government-worldwide, health-insurance-dach, payments-fintech, pqc-security-vendors, quantum-research-universities, secure-communication, semiconductors-hardware, telecom.

sector.description: Sector watch-list key to retrieve. Default: cyber-agencies-worldwide.

tools.name: get_tls_attestation
tools.description: Paid, non-read-only x402 tool: $5.00 USDC on Base per domain (x402 v2, exact scheme). Starts a fresh external TLS probe and requires an x402-compatible MCP client with a funded Base USDC buyer wallet. Payment happens ONLY after a valid signed payment; agents must NOT auto-retry paid calls without explicit spend authorization. Returns a structured v2 auditor EVIDENCE BUNDLE not available for free: (1) signed_receipt (fresh Ed25519 JWS TLS receipt), (2) cbom (CycloneDX 1.6 Cryptographic Bill of Materials), (3) auditor_pdf (token-protected printable auditor PDF download URL with timestamp, methodology, explicit limits and SHA-256 digest), and (4) integrity.bundle_jws (bundle-level Ed25519 JWS binding the PDF and CBOM). Preview format for free at /api/v1/attestation/sample.pdf. Measurement limits: one vantage, one public IPv4 endpoint, port 443; may not represent an origin behind a CDN. Supporting transport evidence (NIS2/DORA), NOT a legal compliance certification. Basic scan and receipt stay free (scan_tls). Calling without a signed payment returns the x402 PaymentRequired challenge and never charges.

domain.description: Public hostname to probe and attest on port 443. Requires an x402-compatible MCP client with a funded Base USDC buyer wallet.

tools.name: create_full_report_order
tools.description: Create a one-time full-report payment order for an existing scan_id. Does not transfer funds. Only set consent_immediate_delivery=true after the payer has expressly agreed to immediate digital delivery and applicable withdrawal terms. Returns order_id, exact Polygon USDT amount, and recipient address; then submit the confirmed transaction hash via verify_full_report_payment.

consent_immediate_delivery.description: Must be true only after the payer explicitly agrees to immediate digital delivery and the applicable withdrawal-right terms.

scan_id.description: Scan identifier returned by scan_tls for the domain whose full report is being ordered.

tools.name: verify_full_report_payment
tools.description: Submit the payer-provided Polygon transaction hash (tx_hash) and order_id from create_full_report_order. The server verifies the confirmed on-chain USDT transfer, exact order amount, and recipient address, returning the private report URL only after confirmation.

tx_hash.description: 0x-prefixed 64-hex-character Polygon transaction hash of the confirmed USDT payment.

tools.name: register_agent_affiliate
tools.description: Programmatically register an AI agent or operator for the Quantum Aether partner programme and immediately receive a ?ref=CODE link. Earns 30% of monitoring payments for 12 months and 20% of one-time reports, packs and audits. Paid monthly manually by the owner (PayPal or USDC on Base/Arbitrum) after a 30-day refund hold, from $50 minimum. No automatic payouts; no spam or unsolicited cold emails.

channel.description: Optional description of how this agent or operator recommends Quantum Aether.
examples: CI/CD security assistant recommending PQ-TLS monitoring

consent_terms.description: Must be true: accepts 30% monitoring (12m) / 20% one-time commission, monthly manual payout by owner after 30-day hold (min $50), no spam/cold email without consent, no self-referrals.

contact_email.description: Operator email address used for monthly manual payout coordination and notices.

payout_destination.description: 0x EVM address for USDC, or PayPal email (optional for paypal, defaults to contact_email).

payout_method.description: Monthly manual payout rail: usdc (Base/Arbitrum EVM address) or paypal.

website.description: Optional operator website or GitHub repository URL.
